title: Observability, Logging & Health Monitoring

existing_surface_audited.backend: structured Pino logging, request-id correlation, /health, /ready (DB ping), /system/blockchain/health — already production-grade
existing_surface_audited.python_device_ai: structured Loguru logging with request-id context, /, /health (component status), /system/blockchain/health
existing_surface_audited.frontend: ServerError/SkeletonCards/AdminUnavailable already give every section real loading/error/unavailable states (P6.6)
existing_surface_audited.mobile: mapDioExceptionToFailure already translates every network failure to a user-facing message

design_decision: did not add /health/live, /health/ready, /health/blockchain as parallel route aliases — the existing /health+/ready(+/system/blockchain/health) trio already delivers liveness+readiness+dependency health; adding duplicate routes for the same capability would violate the no-duplicate-logic / no-unrequested-churn rule

gaps_fixed.summary: no request/blockchain metrics existed; added dependency-free MetricsRegistry + GET /api/v1/metrics + blockchain onCheck hook, deliberately not Prometheus (no scrape target in this environment)
/health never checked database connectivity; added ping_engine() and a conditional database component, only when a backend actually uses postgres (mirrors P7.2's production-safety rule)

no request/Fabric-transaction metrics; added utils/metrics.py wired into existing RequestContextMiddleware + GET /metrics; Fabric tx counters recorded at the submitTransaction/evaluateTransaction call surface, not the internal P6.2 RPC implementation

no structured logging or connectivity diagnostics existed; added AppLogger (dart:developer-backed, kDebugMode-gated) to both apps, wired into api_exception.dart (both) and sync_manager.dart/sync_providers.dart (collector only, per its offline-queue design)

python_full_suite.note: 1081 P7.2 baseline + 14 new; pre-existing benchmark flake did not reproduce this run

tests.new_code_lint_hygiene: ruff/mypy scoped to every touched file; 1 genuine mypy error in this phase's own new code found and fixed; all other findings confirmed pre-existing via git diff and left untouched

security_considerations: GET /metrics (both services) public read-only, exposes only aggregate counts/timings by route template, no raw URLs/bodies/PII — same sensitivity bar as existing /health
ping_engine() never logs connection strings or credentials
AppLogger never activates in release builds (kDebugMode gate) — no production mobile log sink exists at all
environmental_limitations: No metrics scrape target (Prometheus/Grafana) exists in this environment — addressed by design with a lightweight JSON summary instead of an unused dependency, not left as an open gap
